_comment: The client's file folder in the agency Google Drive (agency rule, 3 Nov 2026). Fill in at kickoff: folderId is the last part of the folder link (drive.google.com/drive/folders/<folderId>). The folder must be shared with the import service account as Viewer (its email is in docs/drive-import.md). The import runs on the 1st of each month and on demand, converts photos to WebP, removes location data, and opens a pull request. Subfolders are matched by name, ignoring the leading number and case. Folders under listOnly are never copied into the site; the pull request lists what is in them.
